message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of some of the most significant and busiest airports across the United States:

| Airport | City / State | IATA Code | Notable Features |
|---------|--------------|-----------|------------------|
| **Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International** | Atlanta, GA | ATL | Largest passenger hub worldwide; massive domestic & international traffic. |
| **Los Angeles International (LAX)** | Los Angeles, CA | LAX | Major West Coast gateway with extensive global connections. |
| **Chicago O’Hare International** | Chicago, IL | ORD | One of the world’s oldest hubs; high volume of flights on all continents. |
| **Dallas/Fort Worth International** | Dallas–Fort Worth, TX | DFW | Large mid‑size hub connecting North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia. |
| **Denver International** | Denver, CO | DEN | Fastest-growing U.S. airport; key Midwest/West hub. |
| **John F. Kennedy International** | New York City, NY | JFK | Primary East Coast gateway into the Americas, Africa, Europe, Middle East. |
| **San Francisco International** | San Francisco, CA | SFO | Strong Asian connectivity; tech‑industry focus. |
| **Seattle/Tacoma International** | Seattle, WA | SEA | Gateway to Pacific Rim; strong airline alliances. |
| **Miami International** | Miami, FL | MIA | Key Caribbean & South American link; diverse cultural mix. |
| **Orlando International** | Orlando, FL | ORF | Heavy tourist traffic; family-friendly services. |
| **Phoenix Sky Harbor International** | Phoenix, AZ | PHX | Growing Southwest hub; desert climate operations. |
| **Washington Reagan National** | Washington DC | DCA | Close proximity to federal government; short-haul flights dominate. |
| **Boston Logan International** | Boston, MA | BOS | Northeast corridor hub; historic significance. |
| **Houston Hobby & George Bush Intercontinental** | Houston, TX | HOU/HOU? | Two major Texas airports serving different market segments. |

These airports serve as critical nodes for both domestic travel within the U.S. and international routes around the globe. They’re known for their infrastructure capacity, frequent flight schedules, and role in shaping air transport trends.
